description: This file defines a Builder object with methods for creating and manipulating DOM elements, including node creation, attribute handling, and child element appending. It is part of the scriptaculous library for dynamic UI effects.

methods.name: node
methods.description: Creates a DOM element with specified attributes and children based on the element name.

methods.name: _text
methods.description: Creates a text node with the given text.

methods.name: _attributes
methods.description: Generates a string of HTML attributes from an object.

methods.name: _children
methods.description: Appends child nodes or text to a DOM element.

methods.name: _isStringOrNumber
methods.description: Checks if a parameter is a string or number.
